name: FjallJournal::next_sequence_at_write
signature: pub fn next_sequence_at_write(&self, run: RunId) -> Result<EventSeq, JournalError>
semantics: Returns the expected next event sequence for run: ZERO when no events stored, otherwise last_durable_seq.succ(). Key-only prefix iterator; no value decode. Returns SequenceOverflow on u64::MAX saturation.

name: JournalError::SequenceMismatch
signature: SequenceMismatch { run: RunId, expected: EventSeq, actual: EventSeq }
semantics: Write-time typed error: the supplied event.seq() did not match next_sequence_at_write(run). Distinct from SequenceGap (replay-time).

name: JournalError::SEQUENCE_MISMATCH_AT_WRITE_CODE
semantics: Diagnostic code from the 0x404x reserved block (sibling of REPLAY_KEY_MISMATCH_CODE=0x4040 and REPLAY_ENVELOPE_SEQUENCE_MISMATCH_CODE=0x4041).

name: SymbolicCode::JOURNAL_SEQUENCE_MISMATCH_AT_WRITE
semantics: Symbolic code registration required; verify via CODE_REGISTRY (location TBD).

name: next-sequence-at-write invariant
text: For every successful write of JournalEvent with run=R and seq=S, S == next_sequence_at_write(R) at the moment of write. The contract is monotonic and atomic relative to the Fjall commit.

name: no-silent-rewrite invariant
text: Append paths MUST reject any event.seq() != next_sequence_at_write(run) with JournalError::SequenceMismatch. NEVER rewrite event.seq() to the expected value. NEVER downgrade the error to a warning.

name: batch-atomicity on first mismatch
text: append_strict_batch([e1, e2, ...]) MUST reject the entire batch atomically when any element's seq != next_sequence_at_write(run). No partial commit; C6 guard precedence is preserved.
